approved_amendments.scope: Implement the monthly repository hygiene process, read-only inventory tool, and review template described in this WCS.
limits: The inventory tool must not alter repository files.
No automatic deletion, movement, renaming, or archiving.
Each cleanup run requires separate itemized WCS and founder approval.
Do not execute existing broad cleanup scripts.

execution.objective: Implement the approved monthly, review-led repository hygiene process with read-only candidate discovery and a separate itemized approval gate for cleanup.

cadence.operation: A steward initiates and reviews each monthly cycle.

success_criteria: Create an operating procedure for starting, reviewing, recording, and closing a monthly hygiene cycle.
Create a read-only candidate inventory tool that does not delete, move, rename, archive, or modify repository files.
Record tracked, untracked, and ignored paths separately; never read secret values or follow symlinks outside the repository.
Generate a dated report and machine-readable register for each monthly cycle.
Use the approved lifecycle standard to classify candidates and record evidence, confidence, references, ownership, and recovery value.
Require a separately reviewed, itemized cleanup WCS naming exact paths and evidence before any cleanup operation.
Require founder approval of each itemized cleanup scope; monthly process approval is not blanket deletion authority.
Do not invoke existing broad cleanup scripts or execute cleanup automatically.
No Builder, runtime, package, database, Supabase, or deployment changes.

unlocks: Monthly read-only candidate review cycles after this WCS is separately approved.
Itemized cleanup WCS cycles only for candidates that pass review and receive founder approval.

forbidden_surface: Package creation, regeneration, overwrite, or mutation
Deployment, database, Supabase, and secret values

founder_runtime_test.test_definition: No application runtime change is authorized.
founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: A draft monthly process implementation WCS is staged for founder review.
